channel.title: Andalusia Star News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Andalusia Star News (andalusiastarnews.com)

item.title: Gary Lynn Thompson Obituary
item.description: Gary Lynn Thompson, 75, of Attalla, AL, died Feb. 17, 2026. A devoted family man and follower of Christ, he will be remembered Feb. 21 at Fairmount Baptist Church in Red Level.

item.title: Mary Lillian Kirkland Obituary
item.description: Obituary: Mary Lillian Kirkland, 87, Andalusia, AL, devoted church member, nurse and councilwoman who loved family and travel, dies Feb. 15; services Feb. 20.

item.title: The African Children’s Choir to perform at FBC Opp
item.description: The African Children’s Choir, ages 8–10 from vulnerable backgrounds across Africa, brings a free, donation-supported concert of hymns and African worship to FBC Opp.

item.title: Letter to the Editor: In defense of the Pine Hills Storage Hub
item.description: Covington County oil and gas veteran defends Pine Hills Storage Hub CCS project, arguing HB 61’s proposed ban ignores strict safeguards and threatens local economic opportunity.

item.title: APL to celebrate 100 years of historic building
item.description: Andalusia Public Library will mark 100 years of its historic former post office building with a public reception April 1, 2026, 11:30 a.m.–1 p.m., at 212 South Three Notch Street.

item.title: County GOP Forum held Feb. 9
item.description: Covington County Republicans gathered Feb. 9 at David’s Catfish House for a candidate forum ahead of the May 19 primary, featuring local hopefuls for BOE, sheriff, revenue commissioner and coroner.

item.title: Study Club celebrates Semiquincentennial
item.description: Study Club of Andalusia hosts DAR Regent Carolann McGlaun Mullins for a program on America’s 250th Semiquincentennial, marking 1776–2026.

item.title: Mizell honors community and American Heart Month
item.description: Mizell Memorial Hospital marks American Heart Month in red, while its Auxiliary’s Valentine’s Tree lets residents honor loved ones and local leaders with heart ornaments.

item.title: APL honors Black History through weekly author features
item.description: Andalusia Public Library marks Black History Month with weekly spotlights on African American authors, from S.A. Cosby and Tracy Deonn to Amy DuBois Barnett and Kwame Alexander.

item.title: Lillian Connally Renfroe Obituary
item.description: Obituary: Lillian Connally Renfroe, devoted wife, mother and “Nana,” died at home Feb. 15. A memorial service will be held Feb. 21 at 11 a.m. at Trinity Presbyterian Church in Pensacola.
